nearest.description: Nearest Euclidean condition after training-only weighted standardization; average exact-distance ties, CPU

ridge.description: Linear ridge on training-only weighted-standardized features, CPU

evaluations: earth_logo: leave one ground condition group out, 35 rows / 19 groups
microgravity_logo: leave one provisional specimen group out, 34 rows / 11 groups
earth_to_microgravity: train on all 35 Earth rows, test all 34 flight rows; no tuning on flight results
microgravity_strict_units_logo: secondary sensitivity, exclude U01 from both fitting and testing
protocol.training_weights: Each group has equal total weight, normalized to mean row weight 1 within each training fold.
protocol.prediction_constraint: Clip negative rate predictions to zero for all methods; record unclipped predictions and clipping count.
protocol.primary_metric: Mean across groups of within-group MAE, mm/s
protocol.development_gate: At least 20% lower group MAE than the better of median and nearest-condition baselines, reported separately by evaluation. This is a provisional relative criterion, not demonstrated practical utility.
protocol.absolute_error_gate: Not established with a domain user; do not certify practical accuracy in this exploratory round.
protocol.error_resampling: 2000 paired group bootstrap resamples of recorded errors; descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Overlapping CV training sets and small groups limit inference. Not prediction intervals.
protocol.selection_policy: No hyperparameter search, early stopping, or outcome-driven model changes during this round. Report every predefined model including failures. No winning model certified from this comparison alone.
